focus: align Android login, session UI and command controls with backend role/capability policy

android.pin_persistence: RAM only; cleared on logout/activity destroy

policy.admin: all current CommandType values allowed by role
policy.user: arm/disarm and valve commands only when backend capability permits
policy.guest: strict monitoring-only; control commands denied even if a malformed backend response sets operator capabilities true

regression.android_unit_tests: testDebugUnitTest runs before assembleDebug in GitHub Actions
